capabilities: Overlay cover images on embedded canvas nodes
Set canvas view backgrounds from frontmatter
Configure cover keys per canvas via the Properties panel
Reload embed cover hooks with a command
extras: Depends on an internal Obsidian API (embedRegistry) that may break in future updates; desktop only, mobile not supported; includes a Chinese-language README.
intentEvidence: This plugin is an extension built on top of Advanced Canvas.
problem: Obsidian embeds of .canvas files render with no visual cover, and canvas views have no per-canvas background control.

relations.evidence: This plugin is an extension built on top of Advanced Canvas.

summary: Adds cover images to embedded .canvas files and optional canvas view backgrounds, configured per canvas through frontmatter.
